articles.summary: First Quarter Net Revenue Grows 15.4% Versus Prior-Year Period to $187.2 Million Announces Plan to Wind Down Butter Business Adjusts Fiscal Year 2026 Net Revenue Outlook to $775 Million to $800 Million and Adjusted EBITDA Outlook to $0 Million to $10 Million Vital Farms (Nasdaq: VITL), a Certified B Corporation that offers a range of ethically produced foods nationwide, today reported financial results for its first quarter ended March 29, 2026.
